# Synthetic example

The fixture for `ponytail-preflight@0.1.0` is deliberately synthetic and contains no user image, model weight or external asset. It is used only to exercise declarative validation.

For a new reference-driven model, call `skill_get` for this Skill, inspect the returned constraints, then use the smallest existing typed path: project/reference intake, an active GeometryProgram path, strict readback, fixed render evidence and user approval. Do not begin by adding a new tool, bundle or unrestricted script.
